Of course, it can feel like a lot at first 🙂 In simple terms, the main denim fit options are:

Skinny: fitted from waist to ankle for a sleek look
Straight: more relaxed than skinny, with an even leg shape
Boyfriend: looser and casual, with a relaxed feel through the hips and legs
Bootcut: fitted through the thigh with a slight flare at the ankle
Flare: fitted up top with a wider flare below the knee
Wide leg: roomy throughout the leg for an easy, more relaxed shape

A few examples from our collection are:

Mia Slim Fit Skinny for a sleek, modern fit
Connie High-Rise Skinny for a contoured, leg-lengthening fit
Catherine Boyfriend for a relaxed, casual fit
Diana Relaxed Straight for everyday comfort
Ana Bootcut for a balanced shape that pairs well with boots
Stella High-Rise Flare for a dressier, fashion-forward look
